title: Periodic and Requested Terms Tier Reviews for the Commercial Credit Account
content:
**Credit policy manual — moving between terms tiers.**

### Clauses

1. Each account is reviewed every credit review cycle of its tier in months, and a customer may request a terms upgrade at any time on an active account.
2. An account moves up to a higher terms tier only when it meets that tier's entry gate in full and its trailing twelve-month on-time payment percentage is at least the higher tier's minimum on-time percentage for limit increases.
3. On an upgrade the credit limit is raised to the new tier's credit limit floor when it is below it and is otherwise unchanged; on a downgrade it is lowered to the new tier's credit limit ceiling when it is above it.
4. At a periodic review an account whose trailing twelve-month on-time payment percentage is below its own tier's minimum on-time percentage for limit increases moves down one tier, except that the Net 10 Starter tier cannot move down.
5. A tier change takes effect for invoices dated on or after the review date; invoices already posted keep their terms.

The on-time payment percentage is, of the invoices whose due date falls in the 12 calendar months ending on the current date, the percentage, rounded down to a whole number, whose balance was reduced to zero by payments, discounts and credit memos dated on or before the due date; an account with no such invoice counts as 100.

### Upgrade and downgrade targets

| Tier held | Upgrade target | Downgrade target |
|---|---|---|
| Corbett Net 10 Starter Account | Corbett Net 30 Standard Account | Corbett Net 10 Starter Account |
| Corbett Net 30 Standard Account | Corbett Net 30 Preferred Account | Corbett Net 10 Starter Account |
| Corbett Net 30 Preferred Account | Corbett Net 45 Business Account | Corbett Net 30 Standard Account |
| Corbett Net 45 Business Account | Corbett Net 60 Corporate Account | Corbett Net 30 Preferred Account |
| Corbett Net 60 Corporate Account | Corbett Net 90 Strategic Account | Corbett Net 45 Business Account |
| Corbett Net 90 Strategic Account | Corbett Net 90 Strategic Account | Corbett Net 60 Corporate Account |

*Hypothetical:* a Corbett Net 30 Standard Account with a limit of 18000.00 upgraded to the Corbett Net 30 Preferred Account has its limit raised to that tier's floor of 25000.00; a Corbett Net 45 Business Account with a limit of 300000.00 moved down to the Corbett Net 30 Preferred Account has its limit lowered to 149999.00.
